title: Blocker
description: One thing the spec does not determine, found by simulating the build. A blocker is not a complaint -- it is a decision the implementer would be forced to make, with the options they would be choosing between.

id.description: Stable slug derived from the requirement and the decision, so the same blocker found by two lenses collides on the same id.

title.description: One line, stated as the missing decision. Not 'the spec is unclear'.

scenario.description: The concrete situation that forces the decision. This is what makes a blocker checkable rather than abstract.

question.description: Answerable in one line. If it needs a paragraph of setup, the lens has not finished its own work.

recommended.description: Must match one option label. The default applied if the user does not object.

impact.description: How far the wrong choice propagates.

reversible.description: Whether a wrong choice is cheap to undo later. Drives whether we ask or assume.

found_by.description: Lens names. Populated by concordance, not by the lens itself.
